body:
I recently received this encouraging note from a Catholic teacher in Taiwan …

 I wanted to thank you for your song Immanuel from Learning to Love . Attached is a PPT I created based on this song in a presentation I gave on the feast of Corpus Christi for a youth group in a Catholic church in Taiwan where I teach and serve. I used Immanuel as I wanted to express the most important point of this feast is the message of a the sacrament of Eucharist as a means to put us with God again.

As I gave the presentation I thought that at the writing and recording of this song so many years ago, I can’t imagine that Brian could have foreseen that one day an American teaching in Taiwan would translate it into Chinese to share with a youth group there.

As a teacher I don’t usually get the see the fruits of what seeds I intent to sow. I wanted to let Brian know that one seed of his song Immanuel bore fruit in Taiwan yesterday. Thank you.

 Thanks for this encouragement!

Here’s the powerpoint, but unfortunately, I can’t get the Chinese characters to translate …
